notes.title: Check out Epic Auto Towers, a game from our son, a professional game developer!
notes.notes:
Hey, everybody!

Our journey into gamdev started after our son, a professional game developer, inspired us, his parents, to get into game development too!

Today he announced his new game: Epic Auto Towers! It's a turn-based strategy game with deckbuilding and autobatler elements. The game is going to be super awesome, so add it to your Wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2116060/Epic_Auto_Towers/

notes.title: Game recently updated
notes.notes: We have recently updated more than 20 levels to varying degrees to make the game more harmonious. And we have also made it easier to control - now using a keyboard or gamepad.

notes.title: Game updated
notes.notes: Most of the levels have been updated to make them more harmonious. And also made more convenient control - now it is carried out from the keyboard or from the gamepad.

notes.title: Game updated
notes.notes: Enter the game and get achievements for previously completed levels!

notes.title: Game updated
notes.notes:
